_note: The fresh start (D-078, docs/design/V2_PLAN.md §1). While on, the app shows none of the personal layer: engine/app/fresh.py takes it out of every pack at the end of the export, and the app skips Sheet rows dated before 'since'. Nothing is deleted: canon/ keeps the six journeys, builds, lineups, studbook and lineage as they were, and docs/ keeps their reports. To bring them back, set 'on' to false and run python3 -I engine/rebuild.py.
why: Zack, 2026-10-25: "we need to eliminate all of my personal history in the game ... everything that I could input, I want that to be blank. And I want to start new and start over and input everything myself."

hides.store.json: your Pokémon (individuals), your builds (provenance yours), the saved team drafts, the breeding lines and proposed lines
hides.library.json: the journey trainer (me) and its versions, and any collection entry that points at them
hides.hq.json: the champion's versions, the chapters, the party, the residents, the program, the studbook lineage, the fathers, the breeding roles, and the staff drawn from them
hides.roles4.json: the team-role reads of the journey companions (me:*)
hides.advance*.json: the Journey Scouting File (each lineup becomes empty)
hides.battle.json: the journey's lineups, characters and coach settings (the Battle Lab reads your v2 teams instead)
hides.scout.json: the journey trainer (me) in the Trainer lab's report engine
hides.arena.json: your journey teams and their Legends entries (sixvsix/cli/arena-pack.mjs reads this file)
hides.capability.json: nothing: its world records name the old Pokémon by id, so with those Pokémon hidden the records match no one (and come back with them)
hides.breeder.json: nothing (it is every line's egg moves, not your records)
hides.sheet tabs: rows in My Pokémon, My Builds, My Teams, My Gear, My Artwork, Arena and Journal dated before 'since'
